lead: Alcoholic drinks a person buys, cellars or collects, grouped by what they are made from and how: wine by colour and grape with appellation archetypes, beer by BJCP style family, whisky by country and style, other spirits, liqueurs, sake and rice wines, cider and mead, ready-to-drink, and no- and low-alcohol alternatives, with producers, breweries and distilleries in the brand register.

depts.t: French wine named by appellation, still, sparkling, sweet and fortified, with the classified estates and Champagne villages inside each; a wine of another country → its own wine department; a grape on its own → Grapes.
depts.ax: Which region and appellation is the wine from, and which rank does it hold?
depts.note: Organised region → district → appellation → classified estate or village. Producers outside a classification are not entries.

b.v: regional → village → premier cru → grand cru (Burgundy); cru bourgeois → 5e–1er cru classé (Bordeaux 1855); IGT → DOC → DOCG (Italy); joven → crianza → reserva → gran reserva (Rioja)
b.w: Official appellation systems and historic classifications set the expected quality and ageing.

ax: What it is and where it comes from: wine by country and appellation, the grape varieties, beer by who makes it, spirits by protected category, then sake, cider, ready-to-drink and no & low alcohol.
key: 1. Is it alcohol-free or low alcohol and made only that way, with no full-strength parent? → No & low alcohol
2. Is it a grape variety you are looking up rather than a bottle? → Grape varieties
3. Is it a wine with a protected place name from France? → Wine of France
4. … from Italy? → Wine of Italy
5. … from Spain or Portugal? → Wine of Spain & Portugal
6. … from Germany, Austria or Switzerland? → Wine of Germany, Austria & Switzerland
7. … from Hungary or Central Europe? → Wine of Hungary & Central Europe
8. … from the Balkans? → Wine of the Balkans
9. … from Eastern Europe? → Wine of Eastern Europe
10. … from Greece or Cyprus? → Wine of Greece & Cyprus
11. … from Turkey, the Caucasus or the Levant? → Wine of Turkey, the Caucasus & the Levant
12. … from the United States? → Wine of the United States
13. … from Canada or Mexico? → Wine of Canada & Mexico
14. … from South America? → Wine of South America
15. … from South Africa? → Wine of South Africa
16. … from Australia or New Zealand? → Wine of Australia & New Zealand
17. … from England or Wales? → Wine of England & Wales
18. … from China, Japan or India? → Wine of China, Japan & India
19. Is it beer? → Beer
20. Is it whisky? → Whisky
21. Is it brandy? → Brandy
22. Is it rum or another cane spirit? → Rum & cane spirits
23. Is it an agave spirit? → Agave
24. Is it gin, vodka or aquavit? → Gin, vodka & aquavit
25. Is it an anise spirit or absinthe? → Anise & absinthe
26. Is it an Asian spirit (baijiu, shōchū, soju…)? → Asian spirits
27. Is it a liqueur? → Liqueurs
28. Is it sake or another rice wine? → Sake & rice wine
29. Is it cider, perry or mead? → Cider, perry & mead
30. Otherwise: a ready-to-drink or mixed pack? → Ready-to-drink & mixed packs

Precedence: a protected wine name (Champagne, Port, Tokaji) is placed by its country before its style; alcohol-free versions of full-strength drinks stay with their parent and appear in the No & low view.
